_note: All thresholds are planning assumptions, not clinical limits. Tune them here; nothing is hard-coded.

bands._source: Moderate-work WBGT action levels in the spirit of ISO 7243 / ACGIH TLV tables. Verify against the published table before quoting.

_sunAdjust: Shade WBGT (Australian BoM approximation) plus up to sunAdjustMaxC for direct sun, scaled by shortwave radiation / 1000 W/m2. Approximate.
